mercenary_company.rule: Mercenary headcount is total company personnel. Command and support are carved from that already conserved total by default. They do not increase company headcount unless a separate exact external attachment owner proves additional bodies.

persistent_formation.rule: formation.personnel is fighting establishment. Unit command and separately attached support sit above fighting strength only when exact conserved owner-force external_personnel_allocations prove those bodies.

authority: Static organizational policy for state, House, private, personal, polity, rebel and mercenary military organizations. Exact manpower, formations, represented people, casualties, operations, ownership, appointments, external-personnel allocations and support allocations remain in their native campaign owners.

command_casualty_exposure.rule: Unit-command bodies and embedded command personnel remain separately conserved where the command model requires them; support duties use ordinary formation manpower and do not create separate casualty pools.

local_100_200.quality_rule: Aggregate hierarchy provides baseline local command; conserved person-lite internal commanders replace the covered share with their actual saved command quality. No flat elite bonus.

maneuver_500_1000.quality_rule: Aggregate hierarchy provides baseline maneuver command; conserved person-lite 500/1,000 commanders replace the covered share with actual saved command quality. No phantom bodies or title-only bonus.

unit_command.continuity_rule: The top commander owns whole-Unit direction. If unavailable, lawful successor and internal subordinate command continuity applies through exact command state.

formation_command_structure.internal_officer_rule: Every internal command node is an assignment held by a soldier already inside the formation's fighting establishment. Materializing that commander converts one anonymous formation body into a represented person; it does not increase formation personnel.
formation_command_structure.routine_support_function_rule: Routine engineering, logistics, signals, medical handling and administration are duties assigned from existing manpower; they own no extra bodies or command echelon.
formation_command_structure.temporary_subdivision_rule: A persistent cohort or internal command may be divided temporarily for battlefield control without rewriting the conserved cohort ledger or creating another persistent formation.

unit_command.rule: A persistent Unit has one top command-establishment body outside fighting strength. It must be an individually addressable conserved person from an owning or lawfully attached force. Succession and staff support are separate from the top-command body and never create extra manpower.

succession_policy.rule: A persistent Unit has one top commander. Continuity is provided by saved successor order, real subordinate commanders, or explicit staff appointments.
succession_policy.internal_rule: If the top commander becomes dead, captured or incapacitated, the best already-existing lawful successor/subordinate may assume command through normal appointment or contingency logic. The system never mints a replacement officer.

mercenary_command_structure.routine_support_function_rule: Routine engineering, logistics, signals, medical handling and administration are duties assigned from existing manpower; they own no extra bodies or command echelon.
mercenary_command_structure.rule: Mercenary command nodes use the same scale-aware hierarchy, but generic officers remain aggregate. Unit command and support come from the company's existing total headcount unless a separate lawful attachment is saved. Important, exceptional or provenance-backed high-potential officers may later be materialized without changing total company manpower.

unit_command.rule: A materialized mercenary company has one top commander inside its conserved total headcount; other leaders are real subordinate commands or explicit staff roles.

mercenary_training.rule: A living mercenary company uses its quarterly causal review to conduct role-specific aggregate drill when not destroyed or dissolved. Training advances the current capability embedded in each exact troop pool under Sword's ordinary diminishing-return training law; it never creates character records or free headcount. Contracted House Tang defense companies therefore continue professional drill while on standing defensive duty, while deployed companies receive less deliberate drill and rely more on field exposure.

officer_representation_policy.high_potential_evidence_rule: High potential is never inferred from holding a billet. It requires saved screening, cohort, progression, performance, or other exact provenance before individual representation.
officer_representation_policy.loadout_rule: Representation never determines equipment. Explicit personal equipment wins; otherwise resolve a lawful officer loadout from institution, command role, and the physical troop roles actually commanded.
officer_representation_policy.materialization_rule: Officer materialization reclassifies one already conserved body. It never creates manpower, rank, experience, or a replacement body.
officer_representation_policy.rank_billet_rule: Rank is durable career state. Billet and current span may change after casualties/reorganization without altering rank. Aggregate surplus officers remain in the unit cadre reserve.
officer_representation_policy.scale_rule: All ordinary embedded 1,000/500/100 officers are aggregate by default, including House Tang and units under Tang Wei. Only individually relevant officers materialize to person-lite; full characters are reserved for people whose complete personal simulation matters.

operation_depth.rule: Major operations coordinate persistent fighting formations and command personnel. Siege work, baggage, signals and casualty handling use temporary duty allocations from those same conserved bodies.
